subject: general
question: Six students A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. B is an immediate neighbour of both F and E. C is sitting second to the left of B. A is sitting immediate left of C. F is sitting second to the left of A. Who is the immediate neighbour of A and F?
solution:
**Six Students:** A, B, C, D, E and F.

1) C is sitting second to the left of B. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0576d6e2ed157af3bbb600e449e6699f89bbc2658c9f792b678451c0b2f361b.png] 

2) A is sitting immediate left of C. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/688554fb260a6c0f3abf65dc0620e901b996fa1c087c9718c398165a1bfb0aca.png] 

3) F is sitting second to the left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41e75aedab8ad736a3b0b155c2f9f04e6d9c91972cbba07e14e561605c459302.png] 

4) B is an immediate neighbour of both F and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2e6cfba27550936585997e5b5bfbaeb56f845af4b054bf44db04dc60c7e64e3.png] 

So, the final arrangement is;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92645276646fef0b3bfa703e4112f3bec61bc1e7d0ac6fa0f05d962cdbfb354f.png] 

Therefore, D is the immediate neighbour of A and F 

Hence, the correct answer is **"D".**
